note: Single source of the Explorer's families: the table on the sheet, the formulas, the validation and the tests are all written from it. call lists the arguments after x, as a, b, c, d for the parameters in order.

families.name: Normal

parameters.label: Mean
parameters.help: Centre of the distribution (mu), in units of x.

parameters.label: Standard deviation
parameters.help: Spread (sigma), in units of x; not the variance.

families.support: Support: all real x. Parameters: mean and standard deviation (not variance).

families.name: Lognormal

parameters.label: Mean of ln X
parameters.help: Mean (mu) of ln X, not of X; the median of X is exp(mu).

parameters.label: Std deviation of ln X
parameters.help: Standard deviation (sigma) of ln X, not of X.

families.support: Support: x > 0. Parameters: mean and standard deviation of ln X.

families.name: Student t

parameters.label: Degrees of freedom
parameters.help: Degrees of freedom (nu); need not be a whole number. Large values approach the standard normal.

families.support: Support: all real x. Parameter: degrees of freedom.

families.name: Chi-square

parameters.label: Degrees of freedom
parameters.help: Degrees of freedom (k); need not be a whole number. The mean is k.

families.support: Support: x >= 0. Parameter: degrees of freedom. The density has a pole at 0 below 2 degrees of freedom.

families.name: F

parameters.label: Numerator df
parameters.help: Degrees of freedom of the numerator (d1); need not be a whole number.

parameters.label: Denominator df
parameters.help: Degrees of freedom of the denominator (d2); need not be a whole number.

families.support: Support: x >= 0. Parameters: numerator and denominator degrees of freedom.

families.name: Gamma

parameters.label: Shape
parameters.help: Shape (k), no unit. Shape 1 is the exponential.

parameters.label: Scale
parameters.help: Scale (theta), in units of x; not the rate. The mean is shape times scale.

families.support: Support: x >= 0. Parameters: shape and scale (not rate).

families.name: Beta

parameters.label: Alpha
parameters.help: First shape (alpha), no unit. Support is 0 to 1.

parameters.label: Beta
parameters.help: Second shape (beta), no unit. The mean is alpha / (alpha + beta).

families.support: Support: 0 <= x <= 1. Parameters: alpha and beta. The density has poles at 0 or 1 below shape 1.

families.name: Exponential

parameters.label: Rate
parameters.help: Rate (lambda), events per unit of x; not the scale. The mean is 1 / rate.

families.support: Support: x >= 0. Parameter: rate, not scale.

families.name: Weibull

parameters.label: Shape
parameters.help: Shape (k), no unit. Shape 1 is the exponential.

parameters.label: Scale
parameters.help: Scale (lambda), in units of x.

families.support: Support: x >= 0. Parameters: shape and scale.

families.name: Uniform

parameters.label: Lower bound
parameters.help: Left end of the support, in units of x.
parameters.note: It must be below the upper bound.

parameters.label: Upper bound
parameters.help: Right end of the support, in units of x.
parameters.note: It must be above the lower bound.

families.support: Support: lower bound <= x <= upper bound.
families.constraint_text: Upper bound must exceed lower bound

families.name: Binomial

parameters.label: Trials
parameters.help: Number of independent trials (n).

parameters.label: Probability of success
parameters.help: Probability of success on each trial (p).

families.support: Support: integers 0 <= k <= trials. Fractional k is truncated by the library.

families.name: Poisson

parameters.label: Mean
parameters.help: Expected number of events (lambda); also the variance.

families.support: Support: integers k >= 0. Fractional k is truncated by the library.

families.name: Geometric

parameters.label: Probability of success
parameters.help: Probability of success on each trial (p). X counts the failures before the first success.

families.support: Support: integers k >= 0 failures before the first success.

families.name: Negative binomial

parameters.label: Target successes
parameters.help: Number of successes to reach (r). X counts the failures before the r-th success.

parameters.label: Probability of success
parameters.help: Probability of success on each trial (p).

families.support: Support: integers k >= 0 failures before the target number of successes.

families.name: Hypergeometric

parameters.label: Sample size
parameters.help: Number of items drawn without replacement (n).
parameters.note: It cannot exceed the population size.

parameters.label: Population successes
parameters.help: Number of successes in the population (K).
parameters.note: It cannot exceed the population size.

parameters.label: Population size
parameters.help: Number of items in the population (N).
parameters.note: It must be at least the sample size and the population successes.

families.support: Support: integers from max(0, n-(N-K)) to min(n, K): successes in a sample drawn without replacement.
families.constraint_text: Sample size and population successes cannot exceed the population size

families.name: Discrete uniform

parameters.label: Lower bound
parameters.help: Smallest value of the support, a whole number.
parameters.note: It must not exceed the upper bound.

parameters.label: Upper bound
parameters.help: Largest value of the support, a whole number.
parameters.note: At least the lower bound and at most 1,000 above it.

families.support: Support: integers from the lower to the upper bound.
families.constraint_text: Upper bound must be at least the lower bound, within 1000
